about_the_game:
About The Demo

In Hunted Within: The Walls Demo, you play the prologue chapter of the game—starting in the Glade Yard, progressing through the Shelters, the Forest Area, and the Abandoned Village. Encounter main story characters, fight turned monsters and deadly giant scorpions, and use the first two main weapons (with upgrades available) throughout your journey.

About Hunted Within: The Walls

"Hunted Within: The Walls" is a gripping first-person horror survival game that throws you into a terrifying world inspired by the intensity of Maze Runner, the visceral combat of Dying Light, and the adrenaline-pumping stealth of Outlast.

Lost with no memory, trapped behind massive walls, and must venture through eerie areas Each delivers a unique horror experience, pushing your courage and curiosity to the limit.

Face increasingly dangerous enemies, from silent stalkers in the forest to horrors lurking in the caves.

Gather resources and blueprints to craft deadly weapons, Items and survival gear that will help you stay alive.

Uncover the truth hidden within the maze by hunting down rare Artifact Stones—essential keys throughout the story, and Find out who's Behind all of this!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains gore, violence against non-human creatures and transformed humans. It features horror elements, jump scares, creepy creatures, and horrifying sounds.

short_description: Dive into a gripping first-person horror Survival game Where you're trapped in a terrifying towering maze. Explore, craft tools and Fight by day, watch out over night when the Darkness hunts you within the walls. Uncover the truth behind the walls and Escape, or become a part of the nightmare.
